notes: Same cmake options as deployment/build-vendor.sh rtlsdr; DETACH_KERNEL_DRIVER=ON and ENABLE_ZEROCOPY=OFF literally (build/07-pz-vstanovlennia.md section 7.1).
Prefix /usr and the multiarch libdir instead of the /opt/srrx-vendor candidate of build-vendor.sh, so the package replaces noble librtlsdr2 2.0.1 at the path its consumers load (SoapyRTLSDR, labrx).

Only the rtlsdr target is built: rtl_tcp, rtl_biast, rtl_eeprom and the other tools are never compiled. Packaging is dpkg-deb from recipe.json, not the noble debian/ directory; porting that packaging stays with the reviewer.
The SONAME, the 37 rtlsdr_* exports and the absence of zero-copy text are CI checks of the arm64 build; V4L hardware tests (V4L-0..V4L-8) stay OPEN.
